events.title: Major Demo Update: New Languages, New Art & Next Fest Ready! 🚨
events.summary: Hey everyone!We’ve been working quietly behind the scenes to prepare Saraab for Steam Next Fest, and today we are thrilled to announce our updated demo!What’s New in This Build:🌍 Full Localization: The demo is now fully playable in 8 languages: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Spanish (Spain), Spanish (Latin America), Brazilian Portuguese, and Arabic! A special thank you to our wonderful translators, who made this possible!🎨 Upgraded Visuals: We’ve added brand new background art.🎬

events.title: Thank you for playing the demo - a short devlog
events.summary: Hey everyone!I wanted to take a minute, literally, to say thank you to everyone who played the Saraab demo. Your comments and feedback have shaped this game more than you know.In this short devlog, I share what Saraab is about, the most challenging part of development along with some early sketches and concepts, and my favourite part of making it.Saraab: Beyond the Veil launches on November 3. If you'd like to support a solo developer, a wishlist means the world.- Rooted Elevation Games

events.title: Saraab launches November 3
events.summary: Seeing Saraab on GameSpot felt surreal. It confirmed to me that this is really happening, and it gave me the push to work at full speed and finally submit the game for approval.We're on track, thankfully, and Saraab: Beyond the Veil launches on Steam on November 3. I can't wait to share with you all what the full game brings.Alongside the GameSpot feature, we released a new trailer and new capsule art. It was shaped by your feedback, so thank you to everyone who shared their thoughts.What's wait

events.title: Saraab OST playlist is live! + thank you for playing the demo
events.summary: Hi everyone!The Saraab Original Soundtrack playlist is now live! You can listen to it outside the game and revisit the emotions of the story at your own pace. These are the tracks featured in the game with one extra. The remaining tracks are still in the works but I will be sharing them after full game release.This soundtrack isn’t written as “horror music.” Instead, each piece is how I imagine the character's essence or the feel of the scene. events.title: Saraab Demo v1.0 is out now!
events.summary: Hi everyone,I’m the solo developer behind Saraab, a psychological horror visual novel about a young woman confronting childhood wounds, family secrets, and a past that refuses to stay buried. The public v1 demo is now live on Steam and itch.io, and the full game script is about halfway written as I move toward a larger v2 demo for Steam Next Fest in October.
